notes.title: [EDITED] Announcement Regarding Livestream and Video
notes.content:
[i][b]Edited 2020-05-04:[/b] After the discussion with the developer, we decided to lift every embargoes. Feel free to produce any video contents related to Cat in the Box![/i]


[strike]As you can guess by the tags applied to our Steam store page, Cat in the Box has multiple endings.

If you're a Streamer or YouTuber, you can progress as much as you want and watch several endings together with your viewers. However, please note that revealing [b]every[/b] endings or secrets is not recommended while you're livestreaming or recording videos.

If that wasn't clear, here are some examples.

[b]FINE:[/b]
[list][*] Watching 2~3 endings by selecting different choices at the end of the game

[*] Finding some secrets or unlocking achievements while playing

[*] Uploading your normal 【 let's play / walkthrough 】 video[/list]

[b]NOT OK:[/b]
[list][*] Watch some endings, and then starting a new game from the beginning to find every possible 【 endings / secrets / achievements 】

[*] Uploading the 【 compilation / guide 】 video that only shows 【 ending scenes / secrets / achievements 】 of the game and 【 where / how 】 to find them[/list]


Feel free to ask us if you're still unsure.[/strike]

Thanks for playing our game!


[i]P. S.[/i] Cat in the Box has its [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Cat%20in%20the%20Box]own category on Twitch[/url]. Consider setting up your category if you're going to stream on Twitch.tv!
